description: the UDP socket CordMgr and CordCon use (CordCon::Udp_): forwards to WWOnline's wnet udp.h (libs\wwonline\wnet, E&B's 0x2C-byte UDP, client 0x8BF990-0x8C0620) and undefines its close / read / write macros (CordCon's members); the capture harness defines the members as its replay socket (M1.4)
